name: Lar Prowltusk
summary: Southwest of Sen'jin Village, Lar Prowltusk watches the Durotar frontier. He guards the young troll settlement and sends travelers against nearby threats.

sections.title: Watcher on the Coast
sections.body: Lar Prowltusk watches the coast southwest of Sen'jin Village. As a Darkspear sentinel, he helps guard the tribe's new home after its people fled their sunken island chain. Hostile neighbors keep harassing Sen'jin Village as the trolls work to secure a permanent home. Lar directs scouts and warriors to watch the coast and curb these attacks, especially those by the Kolkar centaur, giving the settlement room to breathe.

faq.answer: Lar Prowltusk is a Darkspear troll sentinel southwest of Sen'jin Village in Durotar. He guards the settlement's outskirts by enlisting Horde travelers to strike at regional threats before they reach the village.

faq.q: What threats does Lar Prowltusk focus on?
faq.answer: Lar watches for dangers along Durotar's frontier, especially marauding Kolkar centaur packs pushing into troll territory.

faq.q: Where can Lar Prowltusk be found?
faq.answer: Lar keeps watch along the paths southwest of Sen'jin Village in southern Durotar.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you rely on scouts like Lar Prowltusk to guard your tribe's fragile new home in Durotar from aggressive centaur clans and encroaching human forces.
As a member of the Horde, you share Lar Prowltusk's struggle to secure Durotar's borders against threats near your fledgling capital.
